notes:
Top-lines / shorthand notes:
- Company: Spectra Loom builds product analytics + in-app guidance (SaaS).
- Primary motive: reduce latency and cost of semantic search + agent responses while keeping quality.
- Early preference: start on Hosted API (fast run) then move to Dedicated for predictable unit costs + VPC.
- Cost sensitivity: high; finance needs clear ARR/units model to justify Dedicated commit.
- Tech ask: 95th/99th p95 SLOs, <200ms typical target for short chat replies, <50ms embeddings lookup for front-end.
- POC goals (client): 1) demonstrate 2x token-cost reduction via batching + caching, 2) maintain no-regression in QA for summaries, 3) quantify quality delta for INT8 quantization profiles.
- Quote from VP Product (Lauren Kim): "We cannot accept >10% drift in summary accuracy from current model outputs — quality gates required."
- Workshop outcome: immediate 20-30% cost reduction potential identified via aggressive prompt batching + prefix cache for common doc prefixes; further 15% possible with mixed-precision quantization but need eval set.
- Security: wants KMS integration + SAML SSO + audit logs forwarded to Splunk. SOC2 evidence required before Dedicated POC.
- Logistics: finance expects a clear committed throughput \u0026 breakpoints table for Dedicated pricing.
- Risks: quantization may introduce edge-case hallucination on long-form summaries; engineering wants A/B controlled rollout + canary.
- Action items: Redwood to deliver cost-modeling spreadsheet, three quantization profiles tested on client eval set, dedicated pricing options with commit tiers, and updated SOC2/architecture docs.
short_description: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Hosted API -> Dedicated. Running POC + cost-optimization workshop focused on batching, caching, quantization and unit economics.
